note: Complete inventory is not complete normative correctness. Native operator expressions are unchanged with pure result bindings around erased proof code; all other 654 production bodies/attributes and all existing model/lemma tokens are unchanged. Four pure definitions and two proved lemmas are added. Exhaustive byte-pair and boundary-word truth tables supplement the universal proof. Placement, mask/shift integration, wire mapping and normative translation remain separate; full raster/pixel correctness is not inferred. Earlier exact composition/storage/frame, reset, metadata, retention and other helper guarantees remain. Only MMR capacity accounting remains a runtime/proof substitution; no new assumptions, weaker memory policy or normative approval are introduced. Broader semantic/caller/conformance gaps still block release claims.
